query: INSERT INTO items (vault_id, item_id, ver, epoch, wire, h_item, tomb, size, seq, current) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?) ON CONFLICT (vault_id, item_id, ver, epoch) DO UPDATE SET wire = excluded.wire, h_item = excluded.h_item, tomb = excluded.tomb, size = excluded.size, seq = excluded.seq, current = excluded.current
